metrics.market_cap_basis: rough_screen_row historical signal: 800,000,000 shares, HKD 0.295 close on 2024-05-08, HKD/CNY 0.904434 on 2024-05-07

cash_breakdown.item: RMB-denominated cash and bank balances subject to PRC remittance restrictions
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Base accessibility haircut 0.70 for Mainland China subsidiary cash without parent-only cash split, multiplied by 0.753 parent-equity/total-equity attribution to avoid crediting minority interests' share to listed-company shareholders.
cash_breakdown.reason: Annual report disclosed RMB252.795m cash and bank balances denominated in RMB, with remittance out of the PRC subject to exchange control restrictions.

cash_breakdown.item: Residual cash, short-term deposits and time deposits not identified as RMB-restricted
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Residual balance is not disclosed as RMB-restricted; use 0.95 for listed/offshore or unrestricted group cash, while keeping a small friction reserve.
cash_breakdown.reason: Total cash equivalents plus current time deposits were RMB301.560m; deducting RMB252.795m disclosed RMB-denominated restricted-remittance balance leaves RMB48.765m.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Deducted after asset haircuts rather than included in detachable cash; sized conservatively at roughly 1.7 months of revenue and over two months of cash operating expense excluding depreciation.
cash_breakdown.reason: Port operations require cash for payroll, maintenance, suppliers, tax timing and service obligations linked to RMB40.640m contract liabilities.

cash_breakdown.item: Bank borrowings and utilised banking facilities
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Interest-bearing bank debt would be deducted at 100%, but none was outstanding.
cash_breakdown.reason: Annual report note 27 disclosed RMB115.812m banking facilities were unutilised at 31 December 2023.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Not mechanically deducted because it is an ordinary office lease required for continuing operation; lease cash burden is reflected in operating profit and cash-flow quality.
cash_breakdown.reason: Annual report note 25 disclosed RMB1.591m lease liabilities.

cash_breakdown.item: Bank acceptance bills receivable at FVOCI
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Not treated as detachable funds because these are operating receivables with recourse exposure on discounted/endorsed bills.
cash_breakdown.reason: Annual report note 19 disclosed bills receivable maturity of 3 to 6 months and continuing involvement exposure.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Not included in detachable cash because the properties are warehouses for port operation, partly pledged to banking facilities and some title certificates were still in process.
cash_breakdown.reason: Annual report note 15 described the properties as warehouses for port operation and disclosed RMB15.2m pledged amount.

profit_quality.assessment: Main operations converted profit into cash well in 2021-2023, but the sustainable distributable denominator is reduced for non-operating income, PRC subsidiary cash remittance constraints, minority interest and local port throughput cyclicality.
adjustments: Started from the recent three-year parent net profit profile: RMB57.206m in 2021, RMB64.092m in 2022 and RMB59.140m in 2023; median was RMB59.140m.

Removed a conservative after-tax attributable estimate of bank interest income, investment property fair value gain, government grants/rewards, disposal gain and exchange gain; rounded pre-haircut distributable cash profit to RMB53.000m.

Used 0.85 profit haircut because operating cash flow exceeded profit and PPE capital expenditure was manageable, but the business is tied to Chizhou port throughput, local mining/cargo demand and Mainland subsidiary remittance.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Operating cash flow was RMB129.782m in 2021, RMB100.058m in 2022 and RMB89.535m in 2023; PPE additions were RMB20.268m, RMB14.371m and RMB5.045m respectively.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: High cash conversion supports a relatively high factor, but not 1.0 because part of profit comes from interest/grants/fair value and distributability is constrained by PRC subsidiaries and minority interests.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Three-year median operating cash flow divided by median parent net profit is about 1.51x before minority and classification adjustments.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed; three-year median PPE additions of RMB14.371m were used as a cross-check and did not consume most operating cash flow.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Working capital did not show sustained cash absorption; 2023 receivables decreased and customer deposits remained material.

limitations: Parent-only cash and subsidiary cash split were not disclosed; cash haircut therefore embeds both PRC remittance restrictions and minority-interest attribution.
Market cap is the historical rough-screen signal date amount in CNY, not a fresh live market-cap pull.
Maintenance capital expenditure was not separately disclosed; the analysis uses PPE additions and multi-year cash flow as a conservative cross-check.
